messages:
Jordan (Design): sharing a new compact layout for Version History — aim is to let power users scan many versions quickly. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/versions-compact. key asks: inline rollback thats low-friction but reversible, a subtle allocation gradient bar for canaries, and clear SR updates when a rollout changes. thoughts?
Priya (PM): love compact. product note: rollback should show the target version in the action and also show a short safety indicator: "can be undone for 10m". we should avoid surprise rollbacks from accidental clicks.
Luca (Eng): doable. implementation concerns: 1) if we render 200 rows we need list virtualization; 2) inline rollback should be a two-step affordance (icon -> confirm) to reduce accidental triggers; 3) will emit an event to audit logs on confirm.
Nina (A11y): a11y points: the two-step flow must be keyboard operable and announced. avoid hover-only affordances for important info (allocation %). add `aria-expanded` on rows that reveal actions and `aria-controls` for the expanded panel. also ensure color alone is not the only signal for canary severity.
a11y-bot: scan results: gradient bar passes contrast for large visible portions but the tiny legend text fails (ratio 2.8:1). recommend increasing font weight or swapping to #30363A for legend.
Jordan (Design): good catch. alternative: show the percent as inline numeric (muted) and a thin gradient bar for quick visual. but if inline percent is visible it may increase row height.
Priya (PM): prefer inline numeric for clarity, but keep rows compact. maybe collapse the percent into a `detail` region that is revealed on focus/tab. however Nina's point about keyboard-only users means it must be visible on focus.
Luca (Eng): technical compromise: show percent as `aria-hidden` on default and render a visually identical text node when focused using `:focus-visible` to avoid layout shift. basically: default small element with `visibility: hidden;`, on `:focus-visible` flip to `visibility: visible;`. needs testing for SR behavior though.
Nina (A11y): don't use `visibility: hidden` for content intended for screen readers. it will be ignored. better: keep the percent in DOM, visually hide with `opacity: 0.01` but keep accessible, then increase opacity on focus. also add `aria-live="polite"` region for status updates like "Rollback started".
Jordan (Design): OK update: keep percent text in DOM but visually subdued; on keyboard focus it gets full contrast. microcopy suggestion for the inline confirm: primary label = "Rollback to v{X}" and secondary helper = "Can be undone for 10 minutes."
Priya (PM): question on confirm pattern: 1) inline confirm that replaces the row actions with "Confirm rollback / Cancel" 2) slide-in tray that shows impact and requires acknowledge. Leaning 1 for speed, 2 for high-risk ops.
Luca (Eng): agree. we'll gate tray for rollbacks that modify infra flags or have migration flags set. otherwise inline confirm for regular service rollbacks. remember to emit a websocket event so Console can show progress realtime.
Nina (A11y): for inline confirm ensure keyboard focus moves to the primary confirm and that pressing Escape cancels and returns focus to the row toggler. add `role="alertdialog"` only for tray modal flows, not inline.
a11y-bot: suggestion: add `role=\"status\"` to progress containers and set `aria-atomic=true` for clear announcements.
Jordan (Design): coupling items: 1) visual: add subtle divider every 10 rows to aid scanning, 2) microcopy: use explicit version in CTA, 3) accessibility: percent always in DOM, stronger legend contrast, aria-live on status. I'll push updated frames by lunchtime and annotate keyboard flow.
Priya (PM): please add a note in the figma about audit-log message text (we want: "User X rolled back service Y: v3.1 -> v3.0"). also include the undo window TTL.
Luca (Eng): I'll prototype virtualization and keyboard focus behaviors. will also add an experiment flag so we can toggle the inline confirm vs modal tray for 2 weeks. PR will reference task: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-942.
Nina (A11y): I'll re-run accessibility smoke once Jordan updates. quick checklist: keyboard order, aria-expanded, aria-live, color contrast for legend, focus-visible ring at 2px.
Jordan (Design): thanks all  will update figma + post annotated screenshot here. :sparkles:
